build_linformer_model: build a LinformerModel instance by calling build_model with args and a fairseq task
build_linformer_encoder: build a LinformerEncoder by passing args and a source dictionary to the constructor
configure_base_architecture: configure the base linformer_roberta architecture with 12 layers and 768 embedding dimensions
configure_large_architecture: configure the linformer_roberta_large architecture with 24 layers and 1024 embedding dimensions
add_linformer_args: add Linformer-specific CLI arguments like compressed ratio and shared KV to an argparse parser
